topics.title: frequency response
topics.essence: An LTI system can only scale a sinusoid and shift it in time. H(jω) says by how much at each frequency.
topics.check: A sinusoid at 1 kHz goes into an LTI system. Which frequencies can come out, and which two numbers describe the change?

links.why: Put e^(jωt) into an LTI system and the same phasor comes out, scaled and turned by H(jω).
e^(jωt) is to an LTI system what an eigenvector is to a matrix, and H(jω) is its eigenvalue.
Solve the circuit with impedances, sweep ω, and V_out/V_in traces out H(jω).
